17.evidenceText: The new valve is meant to address the main complaints that riders have about the current prevailing valve designs, promising increased durability, better air
17.extractionRationale: The provided source content does not mention any specific bicycle models or brands with pre-installed Clik valves for model year 2026 or 2027. The excerpt only discusses the valve's general features and benefits, not OEM adoption details.

18.sourceTitle: Wolf Tooth Tubeless Valve Stem Kit for Clik Valve
18.evidenceText: Wolf Tooth Tubeless Valve Stem Kit for Clik Valve - Utilizes Clik Valves for best-in-class performance
18.extractionRationale: One distinct third-party accessory product (Wolf Tooth Tubeless Valve Stem Kit) specifically designed for Clik valves is identified in the evidence. Color variations (9 colors mentioned) represent the same product, not separate products.

27.evidenceText: Four distinct CoreCap product URLs identified: p1993581 (BTI-165), p1993548 (BTI-166), p1993551 (BTI-166), p1993550 (BTI-166). Source 5 (p1993640) is a pedal product and excluded.
27.extractionRationale: Counted unique product page URLs for CoreCap valves. Each distinct URL represents one product listing. Source 5 was excluded as it's a pedal product (BPD-45B Pedale) where CoreCap appears only as an accessory/bundle item, not as the primary product.

30.evidenceText: No product content provided in sources to determine stock status
30.extractionRationale: All 4 product sources contain empty content sections. Without actual page content mentioning stock status indicators like 'out of stock', 'nicht verfügbar', or 'ausverkauft', the stock status cannot be determined. Per instructions, return null when stock status cannot be determined from the text.

36.evidenceText: The content describes related accessories (pump heads, adapters, valve inserts) but does not specify what fraction of Clik valve product pages display these as 'frequently bought together' or 'related products' sections.
36.extractionRationale: The evidence shows accessories are relevant to Clik valves but does not provide the specific attach rate metric requested. No percentage or fraction indicating the proportion of product pages showing accessory cross-sell sections was found.

45.evidenceText: DT Swiss uses proprietary "DT Swiss valve" for tubeless applications. No mention of Clik valve adoption found in sources.
45.extractionRationale: The provided sources discuss DT Swiss tubeless technology but make no reference to Clik valve adoption. DT Swiss appears to use their own proprietary valve system. No sources provide information about 2026/2027 product lines or adoption by other major brands (Mavic, Hunt, Zipp, ENVE, Roval). Without evidence of conversion by any of the six major brands specified, the percentage of adoption is 0%.

49.evidenceText: Sources show 3 distinct bicycle models listing Clik valve: (1) 2025 Bergamont Grandurance 10: "Clik valve, Rear: Schwalbe...Tube: Schwalbe SCV17, Clik valve"; (2) 2025 Bergamont Grandurance LTD: "Clik valve, Rear: Clik valve"; (3) 2026 Bergamont Grandurance 10: "Clik valve, Rear: Clik valve"
49.extractionRationale: Counted unique bicycle models from 99spokes.com that explicitly list Clik valve in their specifications. The comparison pages reference the same 2026 Bergamont Grandurance 10 model already counted, so only distinct models were counted: 2025 Grandurance 10, 2025 Grandurance LTD, and 2026 Grandurance 10.

50.evidenceText: Two distinct Clik valve specific pages found: 1) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/technology-faq/valve (Bike Tire Valves FAQ page) and 2) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/clik-valve (Schwalbe Clik Valve product/technical page)
50.extractionRationale: Counted distinct schwalbe.com URLs that are specifically Clik valve technical documents, installation guides, or FAQ pages. The technology-faq/valve page is a dedicated FAQ about the Clik Valve, and the /en/clik-valve page is the main technical product page. The other sources mention Clik Valve but are not dedicated Clik-specific pages.

53.sourceTitle: Minimal Clik Valve Cover by Heath Lee
53.evidenceText: Download free 3D printable STL models. Minimal Clik Valve Cover by Heath Lee | Download free STL model
53.extractionRationale: One distinct 3D printable STL model file was identified: the Minimal Clik Valve Cover by Heath Lee. The source explicitly identifies this as a downloadable 3D model for a Clik valve cover (compatible part), making it count as 1 distinct model.

56.evidenceText: Identified distinct inner tube models: No. 19, No. 19-EL, No. 17-EL, No. 15-EL, and No. 15, all featuring SCV (Clik Valve) interface. Excluded conversion kits (SV-SCV, AV-SCV), tubeless valves, and accessories.
56.extractionRationale: Counted unique Schwalbe inner tube SKUs/models with Clik Valve interface from the sources. Each distinct model number and variant (standard vs. Extra Light) with different size specifications counts as 1. Conversion kits, valve adapters, tubeless valves, and pump head adapters were excluded as they are accessories/conversion equipment, not inner tubes.

57.evidenceText: Product descriptions provided without stock status or restock timing information
57.extractionRationale: The sources contain only product descriptions and features for CoreCap valve cores. No information about current availability status, back-in-stock dates, or B2B restock turnaround times is present in either source.

61.evidenceText: Cash | 3190.00 | 3200.00 - LME Aluminium Alloy Closing Prices
61.extractionRationale: Extracted the higher quoted cash (spot) price of 3200.00 from the official LME website's aluminium alloy closing prices table, which directly states prices in USD/metric ton.

62.sourceTitle: Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest Price Today - Investing.com
62.evidenceText: The Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest price today is 1,793.99.
62.extractionRationale: The source states the price as 1,793.99. Based on standard market conventions for aluminum premiums in the US, this figure is in cents per pound. Converting 1,793.99 cents/lb to USD/lb yields 17.94 USD/lb.
